newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese bank shares up on short covering.
newsitem.headline: Japanese bank shares up on short covering.

text.p: Shares in the banking sector jumped in heavy volume on Friday morning, buoyed mainly by active short covering, brokers said.
Shares in Sakura Bank Ltd were up 34 yen at 784. Turnover was 7.18 million shares, making it the most heavily traded stock on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd was up 90 yen at 2,050, Sumitomo Bank Ltd was up 140 yen at 1,620 and Fuji Bank Ltd was up 110 yen at 1,480.

The recovery in bank shares was also helped by Thursday's report by the financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun that the government plans to use public funds to buy collateralised land formerly held by banks saddled with heavy bad loans.
